beats.text: Traditional 3D models shatter under complex lighting. Leaving us with jagged. Blocky artifacts in every render.
beats.visual_focus: A 3D object breaking into low-resolution voxels.

visual_blueprint.title: THE VOXEL TRAP

motif_params.title: THE VOXEL TRAP
motif_params.sub: Discrete grids fail at continuous light representation

beats.text: The villain? Discrete voxel grids. They are memory-hungry. Rigid. And fundamentally incapable of capturing the fluid dance of light across a surface.
beats.visual_focus: A dense, flickering voxel grid struggling to resolve a smooth surface.

beats.text: NeRF pivots to a continuous 5D function. It maps spatial coordinates and viewing angles directly into volume density and emitted radiance.
beats.visual_focus: A ray passing through a coordinate space, transforming into a smooth, glowing radiance field.
